jd_text:
Frontend Engineer (React)
We are a consumer internet company in Mumbai looking for a Frontend Engineer.

Responsibilities:
- Build fast, accessible user interfaces in React
- Own our component library and front-end testing
- Collaborate closely with design

Must have:
- 3-7 years of frontend experience
- React and TypeScript in production
Good to have:
- Next.js, Redux, GraphQL
- Testing with Jest or Cypress
- E-commerce experience

This role is based in our Mumbai office (5 days on-site). No remote option.

requirements.title: Frontend Engineer
requirements.summary: Frontend engineer building React and TypeScript interfaces, on-site in Mumbai.
